title: Taco Vortex Temptation
description: A surreal black-background scene features a towering spiral of tacos on a turquoise pedestal at the center, surrounded by a hypnotic money vortex of swirling dollar bills. Above, a suited man points at a giant smartphone displaying 'BUY NOW SWIPE' while another figure reaches toward floating money symbols; roots, beets, limes, and hot sauce bottles emerge from rocky ground below.
prompt: Surreal dark illustration on black background showing a spiraling money vortex made of swirling dollar bills labeled 'CASH', 'DEBT', 'BILLS'. In the center a tall turquoise pedestal holds three large tacos with purple cabbage, dripping white sauce, and lime wedges. A giant smartphone floats above showing a food ordering app with 'BUY NOW SWIPE' text. A suited man points urgently at the phone while another figure reaches for floating money signs. Roots, beets, limes, hot sauce bottles, and rocks surround the base.
